title: Abatement of nuisance from foul water

versions.Latest:
89. Abatement of nuisance from foul water.—

—   When any pool, ditch, tank, pond, 
well, hole or any waste or stagnant water, or any channel, or receptacle of foul water or 
other   offensive   or   injurious   matter,   whether   the   same   be   within   any   private 
enclosure or otherwise shall appear to the Secretary to be likely to prove injurious to the 
health of the inhabitants or offensive to neighbourhood, the Secretary, may by written 
notice require the owner of the same to cleanse, fill up, drain off or remove the same, or 
to take such measures as shall in his opinion be necessary to abate or remove the 
nuisance.
